description: telemetry-stream-closed.v1: the platform is ending an application telemetry stream (spec 030). `position` is the last reading sent, or the `open` position when none was; the client reconnects with it. `reason` says why: `lifetime` (one hour since `open`), `grant_changed` (the application's grant revision changed; event cursors must be rebuilt), `credentials_changed` (the token was rotated or expired, or the application was revoked), `runtime_unavailable` (the relay to the runtime failed; reconnect with backoff) or `shutdown` (the serving process is stopping). Producer: Laravel's relay; the runtime never sends it. Consumer: applications and the integration SDK.
